title: Sales & shipping
intro: Prepare checkout and delivery in the shared Mr. Space system. Each site keeps its own settings.
phase: Preparation only. Customer payments are not enabled. After setup, checkout, payment confirmation, stock and delivery must pass a separate launch test.
error: Could not save or load. Your draft is retained; retry.
regions_help: Rufcut starts with US only. Enter comma-separated codes, for example US, CA. Each site has its own coverage.
tax: The shop has reviewed tax settings in Square
rates_help: Amounts use this Square account’s currency. These tariffs apply to all selected countries. Leave blank until confirmed. One parcel uses the highest first-item fee plus additional-item fees for the remaining units.
preview_help: Internal calculation only. Prices and stock are re-read from Square. No payment or shipping label is created. Save your preparation before previewing.
tax_pending: Tax is not calculated here; it must be confirmed at checkout.
confirm: I checked the countries, tariffs and product settings. This saves preparation only.
leave: Discard unsaved sales and shipping preparation?
no_items: Connect this site’s Square account to prepare its products. Existing store payments are unaffected.
product_review: At least one reviewed product with tracked stock and a fixed price
next: Next: connect checkout, verified paid orders, shipping labels and tracking; run a test before enabling Buy.
connect_help: Square asks the account owner to approve additional payment permissions. Connecting alone does not enable customer purchases.
quote_error: Cannot quote: check saved product readiness, tracked stock, delivery region and confirmed tariffs.
profile_help: Parcel measurements must include packaging. Do not estimate them from the product photo.
